tool_input.command: for c in af4856a 3059374 0719379 59f3bf7 90c42a0 6185966 d3fef96 f966a62 86b11db d5552e5 1e4bf00 47bc7e3; do echo "=== $(git rev-parse $c)"; git show --stat --format='%s' $c | head -8; git show $c --format= -U1 -- '*.py' | grep -E '^\+' | grep -v '^+++' | head -40; done
tool_input.description: Show diffs for key Armin commits
